summary: The customer called to inquire about a refund for an order they cancelled a week ago. The agent used ambiguous internal jargon initially ('بايوي'), then asked for the order number and subsequently the phone number when the order number was unavailable. The agent checked the system, identified that refunds take 3 to 5 business days, and successfully addressed the customer's query before the call concluded.

evidence.text: أهلاً سيدي، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent failed to state their own name or the company name at the beginning of the call.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، خليني أشيك عالبايوي تبع الطلب. ممكن تعطيني الـ order number لو سمحت؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite tone overall, though the use of internal jargon ('بايوي') detracts slightly from formal professionalism.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، خليني أشيك عالبايوي تبع الطلب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent used reassuring language ('ولا يهمك سيدي') right at the start to comfort the customer regarding the missing refund.

evidence.text: مش مشكلة سيدي، عم بحكي لك من 3 لـ 5 أيام عمل وبيكون المبلغ بحسابك إن شاء الله.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully answered the customer's core question about the refund timeline.

evidence.text: قصدي يا سيدي الـ system عندي، بس مشكلة إذا مش معطيني رقم الطلب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent initially used confusing internal terminology ('بايوي') which required clarification, and expressed minor frustration when the customer didn't know the order number.

evidence.text: مش مشكلة سيدي، عم بحكي لك من 3 لـ 5 أيام عمل وبيكون المبلغ بحسابك إن شاء الله.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent answered the repeated question but ended the call abruptly without asking if the customer needed further assistance or providing a standard closing statement.

evidence.text: الـ refund بياخد عادة من 3 لـ 5 business days لحتى ينزل بالبنوك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The information provided regarding standard bank refund processing times (3-5 business days) is accurate for typical transactions.

evidence.text: طيب ممكن تعطيني رقم التلفون المسجل بالحساب؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent adapted when the order number was missing by asking for the registered phone number, though proper full verification protocol was minimal.
